name: space-conference-reel
description: 20s 9:16 motion-graphics reel for the Annual Space Technology & Satellites Conference (Iraqi Engineers Union), built with HyperFrames.

scripts.build: node scripts/build_geo.mjs && python3 scripts/build_textures.py && node scripts/build_roots.mjs && python3 scripts/build_audio.py
scripts.render:20s: node scripts/build_roots.mjs --variant compact && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.105 render -o output/space-conference-reel_20s.mp4 -f 30 --video-bitrate 14M && python3 scripts/master_audio.py output/space-conference-reel_20s.mp4 && python3 scripts/qa.py output/space-conference-reel_20s.mp4 --expect 20
scripts.render:full: node scripts/build_roots.mjs --variant full && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.105 render -o output/space-conference-reel_full-vo.mp4 -f 30 --video-bitrate 14M && python3 scripts/master_audio.py output/space-conference-reel_full-vo.mp4 && python3 scripts/qa.py output/space-conference-reel_full-vo.mp4 --expect 27.8; node scripts/build_roots.mjs --variant compact
